covers: development and validation of the GitHub remote delivery provider
non-force branch push required for delivery
pull request merge when repository rules and review state permit

implementation_boundaries: Remote delivery remains separately gated by RCL external_side_effect authority with explicitApproval=true.
Git push is non-force; no force-push path is implemented.
GitHub API credentials are read from GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN environment variables and are not accepted in the HTTP delivery payload.
Remote URL credentials and authorization-like output are redacted from delivery receipts.
Provider scope is push, pull-request creation and pull-request merge only; Release, payment and destructive repository operations are absent.
Existing GET /api/git/delivery stays a non-effectful preview; POST /api/git/delivery is authority-gated.
truth_boundaries: The Developer Execution Runtime provider returned transient HTTP 502 during this cycle, so the already-observed DWAC bottleneck and mode were reused from the latest canonical code plus upstream TaoX routing logic rather than claiming a fresh provider execution receipt.
The execution container could not resolve github.com for a fresh clone, so server/main.mjs was reviewed against the branch diff but was not independently node --check executed in that container.
GitHub pull-request create/merge behavior was validated against a deterministic mocked REST contract; the actual canonical PR/merge is performed only after repository review and mergeability checks.
No GitHub Actions run is intentionally triggered by this work; commits use [skip ci] [skip actions].
